scope: Independent visual review for John's decision, covering 19 proposed artwork placements, their original location or crop references, and the actual proof.
result: Advance all 19 photographic placements to John for review.

reconstructions.subject: Cutting finished broad beans at soil level
reconstructions.check: Secateurs contact the stem and the nearby clean stub implies the roots remain.

reconstructions.subject: Cavolo Nero
reconstructions.check: Wrinkled long strap leaves read as kale. The real brick path establishes allotment context.

reconstructions.subject: pH kit and applying lime
reconstructions.check: Vial and reference swatches, landing grains and gloves remain visible. The bench and pale wall match the reference setting.

reconstructions.subject: Open bird netting, fine insect mesh and fleece
reconstructions.check: The three fabric structures read separately and fixings remain visible at print crop. The approved fruit cage is preserved. Review a short replacement caption if the photographs are adopted.

reconstructions.subject: Watering beetroot by the woodpile
reconstructions.revision_requested: Reduce the water force, remove reflective pooling and seat the large front beet naturally in soil. Keep the real garden setting and original camera references.
reconstructions.check: Fine falling water, damp matte soil, shallow timber edge and rooted beet in attempt two.

reconstructions.subject: Solid floor for pots and growbags
reconstructions.check: A continuous paved surface, usable aisle, floor-standing pots and growbag are legible. The floor is illustrative; the greenhouse shell is grounded in real references.
